title: Anomaly detection in brain MRI: a comprehensive review
background_reason: review_for_background: An on-topic narrative review mapping brain MRI anomaly detection (including reconstruction-based deep learning paradigms) that discusses evaluation challenges like false positives and interpretability, but is itself a survey rather than a primary methodological contribution to reconstruction-fidelity evaluation.
